title: useArrayBoundarySeparator collapses __ inside names and creates the exact collision escaping prevents
rationale: sanitizeKey does replace("__","_") whenever useArrayBoundarySeparator is set, commented "Prevent key conflicts with separator". It runs BEFORE escaping. FlattenedPath already makes a __ inside a name harmless, so this control defends against a collision that no longer exists and by rewriting the name it manufactures a real one.
catchesBugClass: Dead defensive code that has outlived the vulnerability it guarded and is now a data-corruption source. Also catches the general class of sanitize-before-encode ordering errors.
cannotCatch: It cannot show which field wins under a non-insertion-ordered input Map. The JSON stack always gives LinkedHashMap so the fixture is deterministic - that determinism is an artefact of the entry point, not a property of the code.

predicted.detail: Neither source name survives, the first value now sits under the name that belonged to the second, and no warning is emitted. Turning the flag off makes both names round-trip perfectly.
